name: Agribio Spirits Limited
about: Agribio Spirits Limited engages in the trading of commodities in India. It also exports lather, jute, and handicraft products. The company was formerly known as Beekay Niryat Limited and changed its name to Agribio Spirits Limited in November 2024. Agribio Spirits Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Kolkata, India.
